Definition: probably bronze or polished spectrum metal
BiblicalUsage: Chashmal is amber, polished bronze, and it appears three times, always in the vision of God's glory. Out of the midst of the fire came the colour of amber, and from the appearance of His loins upward and downward was as the appearance of fire with brightness, as the colour of amber.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is kept for glory alone: it never describes anything but the brightness around the throne.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
